item.description: A world of thrilling battles with your Pokémon await in the Pokémon Champions game, launching for the Nintendo Switch system April 8! The game will also be playable on the Nintendo Switch 2 system…

item.title: South of Midnight studio hiring for new IP

item.title: Tetsuya Nomura posts new art for Kingdom Hearts 24th anniversary
item.description: The revered Tetsuya Nomura has uploaded some new Kingdom Hearts-inspired artwork to celebrate the fact that the beloved series is currently celebrating its 24th anniversary.

item.title: Nintendo introduces a Nintendo Switch 2 filter for the Nintendo eShop
item.description: Finding precisely what you want on the Nintendo eShop can sometimes be a bit of a faff as sometimes you just want to know if there’s a Nintendo Switch 2 version of the game that you are looking for.

item.title: Super Mario Galaxy Movie’s post credits scenes seemingly teases a sequel, and other teases a spin-off

item.title: Turtle Beach reveals Rosalina-themed wireless Nintendo Switch 2 controller
item.description: Fans of the adorable Rosalina will be pleased to hear that peripheral manufacturer Turtle Beach has unveiled a new Rosalina-themed Nintendo Switch 2 controller and it’s available on Amazon.

item.title: Roger Craig Smith teases a Sonic project to be unveiled at IGN live this summer
item.description: Sonic voice actor Roger Craig Smith has taken part in a new interview with Variety during which he revealed he will be joining IGN Live in June “to reveal something tied to Sonic’s big birthday.

item.title: Mario Kart World Version 1.6.0 adds Bob-omb Blast
item.description: After being accidentally revealed too early a few weeks ago, Bob-omb Blast has finally been added to Mario Kart World.

item.title: More Animal Crossing: New Horizons tracks added to Nintendo Music
item.description: Music tracks from the Animal Crossing: New Horizons Version 3.0 update have been added to Nintendo Music.
